candidate.title: DR-Seq
candidate.scope: Assigned Illumina DR-Seq middle-row schematic, resolved to the gDNA-mRNA Sequencing (DR-Seq) implementation described by Dey and colleagues (PMID 25599178; DOI 10.1038/nbt.3129). It depicts same-cell RNA/DNA lysis, barcoded RT, common Ad-2 quasilinear amplification, a physical split, and separate transcript and genomic sequencing branches. The left RNA/DNA icons introduce the biological targets rather than an early sample split. Hi-SCL, inDrop and clipped Drop-seq are independently titled neighboring catalogue rows, not alternative targets of this card. G&T-seq is only a candidate background publication. Broad library-preparation captions remain broad, with primary-supported chemistry and label/order resolutions explicitly qualified below. This is a schematic architecture, not a complete execution protocol or a claim of identical implementations across assay families.
